overview: A thirty-year-old audiovisual professional, voluntarily checks himself into a rehabilitation center due to his alcohol and cocaine use.
title: Yo, adicto

overview: "The Farm" will tell about a team of novice bloggers who accidentally burn down a clip house. Now they have a new challenge - to survive in the village and repay the debt to serious people...
title: Ферма

overview: When Justine Blanchet, mother of 16-year-old Capucine and Pierre-Marie, discovers that her husband, Rémi, has been unemployed for six months and that they are on the verge of bankruptcy, her "perfect" world collapses. Unable to cope with this downgrade, Justine will drag Rémi to the dark side of the force to save face. Lacking a plan B, they will implement a plan C. C for burglary. But it's not so easy to improvise as a burglar when you don't have the codes or the network, when the vigilant neighbors are keeping an eye on things, and when the police are zealously investigating... Drawing unexpected fulfillment from this incredible and dangerous double life, the Blanchets will realize the absurdity of their previous life and will gradually find the path to happiness.
title: Dans de beaux draps

overview: Yunho, a young man who failed to debut, receives a surprising offer: a three-month dating proposal from Jaeho, a gangster. As Yunho starts to open his heart to Jaeho, who appeared at a critical moment to save him, danger looms as those targeting Jaeho begin to approach him…
title: Gangster Like Me Got a Boyfriend

overview: Joanna moves with her young son, Alfie, to the quiet town of Flinstead, seeking a fresh start. However, she quickly becomes entangled in the lives of local mothers and the unsettling dynamics of the community. When Joanna stumbles upon an online rumour about a child killer living in the town, she uses it to win over the mums at the school gate. As gossip spreads, suspicions build, and Joanna finds herself drawn into a web of secrets and paranoia. Balancing her efforts to protect her son with the growing unease in town, Joanna struggles to distinguish between truth and hearsay. With relationships strained and emotions running high, the boundaries between trust and fear blur.
title: The Rumour

overview: Clea Shearer and Joanna Teplin harness their world-renowned organizational expertise to thoughtfully design and specifically tailor and transform homes from the inside out. Assisting them is a team of builders and contractors from homebuilder Taylor Morrison who expertly reconfigures the homes based on each family's lifestyle and needs.
title: Extreme Makeover: Home Edition

overview: Retreat Yourself sees unconventional-wellness guru Donna Preston open the retreat's doors to four famous faces, ready to showcase a series of the weird, wonderful, less than conventional coping mechanisms, proving that self care comes in many shapes and forms. Singer Jake Quickenden, Love Island favourite Kaz Kamwi, social media star Holly Ramsay and radio DJ Dean McCollough are the celebrities checking into the most extraordinary wellness centre, where host Donna is determined to flip classic wellness activities on their head and prove that when it comes to caring for your mental health, it really is all about just doing ‘whatever gets you through.'
title: Retreat Yourself

overview: Shirahata Keita breaks up with his girlfriend when she becomes pregnant. After living as a gigolo for many years, he becomes a refugee. Then he finds a job offer with favorable conditions and decides to apply. However, Keita's life changes when he is assigned as secretary to the cold-hearted and heartless president, Kuroda Joji.
title: Can a Freeloader Make It as a Secretary?

overview: A journey towards maturity and a humorous portrait of toxic masculinities.
title: Vintage

overview: Join CNN Saturday Morning for an insightful and provocative discussion of the week's biggest stories.
title: CNN Saturday Morning Table for Five

overview: The new documentary series Blauw shows what police work really does to officers. In addition to the exciting and challenging aspects of their work, the personal stories and emotions of the officers are central. Who is the person behind the uniform?
title: Blauw

overview: Studious Megan and entitled Dash are forced to serve as Co-Presidents of the Student Council together, where they'll fight each other on everything, including their growing feelings for one another.
title: Couples Council

overview: A single contestant chooses from three potential partners after watching videotaped profiles, then the audience watches their date footage and votes on whether the couple should go on another date.
title: Love Connection

overview: Muffin the Mule is a puppet character in British television programmes for children. The original programmes featuring the character were presented by Annette Mills, sister of John Mills, and broadcast live by the BBC from their studios at Alexandra Palace from 1946 to 1952. Mills and the puppet continued with programmes that were broadcast until 1955, when Mills died. The series then transferred to ITV in 1956 and 1957. A modern animated version of Muffin appeared on the BBC in 2005.
title: Muffin the Mule

overview: Chain Reaction, where one word leads to another, and the right word leads to thousands of dollars.
title: The New Chain Reaction

overview: Dart Kings takes viewers on a nostalgic trip down memory lane through the golden age of darts and shines a spotlight on the nation's most unlikely sporting heroes: Eric Bristow, Jocky Wilson and Phil Taylor. In 1972, darts staggered out of the pub and onto British primetime television, bringing with it a cast of – by today's standards - unlikely sporting heroes. Today, discipline is key to sporting success but in those first moments when the game hit the bigtime, the greatest players mixed extraordinary skill at the oche with boozing, chain-smoking, and an open-door policy to fans and the media alike. Yet it was this combination of skill and raw, unfiltered personality that brought in television audiences of over 10 million and created some of the most memorable characters in sporting history. Against a backdrop of rising unemployment and unrest in 1980s Britain, darts brought entertainment and energy to British audiences. Join us as we explore the incredible journeys of three of the greatest names in darts, charting their rise, rivalries, heartache, and triumphs through the 1970s, ‘80s and '90s.
title: Dart Kings

overview: In 2000, boxes containing top-secret files were found in a garden shed in Cornwall. They detailed the lives and code names of Britain's first female agents sent to the front line during the war. The British spymistress, Vera Atkins, had committed treason by keeping the papers, but she had a reason for doing so. During the war, Prime Minister Churchill desperately needed foreign agents, and though women were not allowed to fight on the front line, they could be sent behind enemy lines as spies. Vera was put in charge of the female spies, and when many of them went missing during the war, never to return, she was determined to find out their fate – in defiance of the British authorities. Vera's files were kept sealed until after she died, but the story of the female spies and the spymistress who led them, which has remained secret for over 50 years, can now be revealed.
title: The Lost Women Spies

overview: Meghan, Duchess of Sussex invites friends and famous guests to a beautiful California estate, where she shares cooking, gardening and hosting tips.
title: With Love, Meghan

overview: Following years of trying to conceive, Tala decides to seek one last, unconventional method to protect her devoted marriage to Zayd and put an end to his family's rebukes, so she hires a surrogate mother.
title: Al Qadar

overview: Career woman, Shimura Eriko, works for a large general trading company on equal footing with the men. She is beautiful and highly educated. Her parents have a house in Tokyo's Setagaya ward. Life seems to be going well for Eriko whose single greatest hang-up is the fact that she does not have any female friends. Her secret pleasure is to read a popular journal written by a housewife influencer of the same age on social media. At one point, she happens to meet Maruo Shoko, the writer of the diary, who lives nearby. Shoko also has no female friends. The two of them who have this point in common, quickly become close. However, some incident causes their relationship to develop in an unexpected direction.
title: Nile Perch no Joshikai

overview: Depicting the forbidden love triangle between a newlywed couple and one of his students!
title: Paint The Teacher With My Colors

overview: Follows an office romance between a nerdy office worker who discovered his ex-boyfriend was actually his boss!
title: I Was Favored By The President

overview: A sentai actor and a former child star clash while filming a BL project. To fix things, an assistant producer arranges a retreat, where their guardian spirits—long-lost lovers—reunite. Can this unexpected bond save the project?
title: Actors High!

overview: Chatroom Japan is a platform for NHK WORLD-JAPAN to engage with international residents in Japan. The public broadcaster aims to develop a new relationship with these viewers and, together, explore ways to make their lives better.
title: Chatroom Japan

overview: Japan - a country of timeless wonder and mystery. The deep spirituality of the Japanese has captured the hearts of many explorers in the past. The journey to uncover the essence of the Japanese spirit, begins.
title: Spiritual Explorers

overview: If it has wheels and goes off road, Ian Johnson will work on it! He takes you along for the "do it yourself" ride, as we tackle everything from simple bolt-ons to full-on fabrication.
title: Build for Off Road

overview: A group of five kindergartners are kidnapped. Meanwhile, geologist Lena and her colleagues prepare for a scientific expedition to Antarctica. When it turns out that the suspect in the kidnapping is Ada, Lena's teenage daughter, the mother postpones her professional plans and returns to her hometown of Wałbrzych to find her daughter, with whom she lost contact many years ago.
title: Czarne stokrotki

overview: Florida Heat takes an unfiltered look at Florida police departments in action.
title: Florida Heat

overview: 6-part documentary series following farmers from all over Ireland over one full farming year. The series brings us into the lives of eleven very different Irish farming families across four seasons of the year. Viewers get to know the men and women who are growing and producing the food we all eat and providing income and employment in our rural communities. The series charts their lives from spring through to winter, how they cope with everything that nature has to throw at them and how they are affected by environmental responsibilities.
title: Saol Na Feirme

overview: Tarrac na Farraige is a landmark four-part documentary series, and a first for RTÉ, which follows the highs and lows of the Irish fishing community in Ireland over a year. With epic aerial photography, this stunning series goes above and below deck, on land and sea, with fishermen from right around the island as they battle challenging conditions to bring home the catch.
title: Tarrac na Farraige

overview: The shocking story of American serial killer Todd Kohlhepp, who often linked his violent crimes to his reviews on Amazon.
title: The Amazon Review Killer

overview: Jamie Oliver brings us flavour-packed, budget-beating recipes that deliver great value, less waste and mouthwatering meals, from mid-week dinners to making leftovers go further.
title: Jamie's £1 Wonders & Money-Saving Meals

overview: Cláudia returns to her rural hometown in order to take revenge for the murder of her family a long time ago. She believes that the Flores family committed the crime and tries to destroy them...
title: Fera Radical

overview: As always, the two former players bring their unique perspectives on the game, offering commentary not just on the latest NBA news but also on the broader sports culture. Whether it's discussing current trends, sharing personal anecdotes, or breaking down the game's biggest moments, this show is a must-watch for basketball fans who want a closer look at the sport from those who know it best.
title: The Draymond Green Show With Baron Davis: Recap

overview: Expect a lively discussion as Sharpe and Ochocinco dive into the most talked-about plays, controversial calls, and standout performances from this week's games. With their deep knowledge of the game and often humorous banter, the pair will provide viewers with an engaging and entertaining recap that goes beyond just the highlights. Whether you're a die-hard football fan or simply enjoy lively debates, this episode promises to deliver plenty of entertainment and football analysis.
title: Nightcap with Shannon Sharpe and Ochocinco: Recap

overview: The bittersweet and captivating story of the people of a Yörük town in the foothills of the Taurus Mountains.
title: Zembilli

overview: On the Money wrapped up the day's news from the worlds of business and everyday life, took a closer look at the money in every story. On the Money literally followed the money through everything from breaking news to politics, to pop culture, and even sports.
title: On the Money

overview: The focus is on Levi Strauss, who comes to San Francisco in the mid-19th century during the gold rush to try his luck. The son of a Jewish peddler from Upper Franconia was to become one of the greatest pioneers in American history. Together with Jacob Davis, a Jewish tailor from Riga who is almost the same age, he develops the blue jeans that will forever be associated with his name.
title: Levi Strauss und der Stoff der Träume

overview: Filmed in studio straight after the main show, the party atmosphere continues on AfterMask, where fans can look forward to chatting and games with the superstar panel of celebrity detectives Mo Gilligan, Davina McCall, Jonathan Ross and newbie Maya Jama, all the tea from host Joel Dommett and exclusive unmasking interviews with the celebrity singers.
title: The Masked Singer: AfterMask

overview: Agnetha Lakshmi Pfeiffer has a whole lot of problems on her hands: Because of her shopping addiction, the bailiff is now after her. She takes the bull by the horns and because she doesn't know where to go, she sets off on a journey that she has been avoiding for the past few weeks: her mother Naina Zareen Pfeiffer has died. She hasn't had a relationship with her mother, a former Bhagwan follower, for many years.
title: Reisen mit Muddi

overview: Travel from Vietnam's northern mountains to the tropical Mekong Delta in search of the last endemic species threatened by extinction.
title: Wild Vietnam

overview: Biochemist Jessie Inchauspé shows us how to improve our health by regulating our blood sugar levels. To prove that her methods really work, Jessie helps people who are experiencing extreme symptoms of health conditions that affect us all.
title: Eat Smart: Secrets of the Glucose Goddess

overview: Does science have all the answers? It seems as if the more we discover, the more problems emerge. Exactly how old is our universe? Why are the two sides of our Moon so different? How did iron from space end up next to the body of Tutankhamun? Why do we even exist? This fascinating BBC science documentary series delves into some of the most perplexing problems faced by science and tries to find some solutions.
title: Science's Greatest Mysteries

overview: Visit the extreme places where the last traces of life are gone but not forgotten.
title: Abandoned Places

overview: Throughout the world, aspiring winter athletes struggling with little support from their country put their lives, financial assets, and time on the line in hopes to compete and represent their country on the most significant competition stage in the world: the Winter Olympics. This documentary series follows six of the worlds most unlikely Winter Olympic athletes as they strive to break barriers and make history for their respective nations. From the Caribbean to the Himalayas, South America to the Middle East, these athletes share the dream of walking into the Olympic arena with the whole world watching as their country's flag waves above them. This is the story of their inspiration. This is their journey.
title: Far From Home

overview: Mallorca is still one of the most popular holiday destinations for Germans. However, more and more people don't just want to spend their holidays there, but dream of settling down as emigrants and living there permanently. Some of them are accompanied in the docu-soap called "We love Mallorca" by the streaming service Joyn.
title: We Love Mallorca

overview: The main character of the film is a nineteen-year-old girl who, despite her young age, has already become a famous sniper. They write about her in newspapers, trumpet on the radio, her courage inspires the soldiers and becomes an example to follow. For everyone, she is a hero, a legend. And who is she in reality - for herself? What is she really experiencing? What secrets does her soul hide?
title: Внимание, говорит Москва!

overview: After her parents divorce, 12-year-old Nastya moves with her mother to the small town of Karachinsk. Having settled in the old house of her deceased grandmother, she transfers to a new school. Relations with classmates do not work out from the first day. However, the school conflict is not the only problem, because inexplicable things begin to happen at home, which she will have to face every day. In a series of these events, paranormal phenomena and creepy secrets will emerge. The life of the heroes will be shrouded in mysticism and the worst thing is hidden in an abandoned building on the outskirts of the city, which everyone calls a haunted house.
title: Моя бабушка – призрак

overview: Top Model is a Brazilian soap opera produced and aired by Rede Globo, between 18 of September of 1989 and 4 of May of 1990 in 197 chapters, replacing what King Am I?, And being replaced by Mico Black. It was the 42nd "novel of the seven" displayed by the broadcaster. Written by Walther Negrao and Antonio Calmon, with collaboration Vinicius Vianna and Rose Calza, directed by Mário Márcio Bandarra and Fred Confalonieri, and general direction of Roberto Talma. Top Model was based Shop Shop aseries written by Antonio Calmon that had only displayed the pilot episode in 1988 and of which the base of actors was assembled for the soap opera the following year.
title: Top Model

overview: The new daily series from RTL, Infernal Relatives, is a thrilling story about how rival families in a small town battle for money, power, and love. Everything is ready for the construction of a battery factory on the outskirts of Pantallós—if István Fejes allows it. The town's mayor, Tihamér Aczél, is determined to make this ambitious Chinese-Hungarian investment happen, a project that would make the entire town wealthy (and especially himself). However, to do so, he must first make peace with István, Pantallós' largest landowner. But István hates Tihamér more than he loves money and declares that the factory will only be built on his ancestral land over his dead body. This deadlock is disrupted by the arrival of the Guba family, former wealthy bankers. After the collapse of their bank and the arrest of Antal Guba, the family is forced to return to this remote and dull village—Antal's birthplace—where their crumbling house barely stands and where the once-influential Antal Guba is known simply as "Tóni" by the locals. The intertwined stories of Pantallós' three families explore themes of personal ambition, money, power, and pride. Only by setting aside their differences, settling their debts, overcoming past heartbreaks, and uniting can these characters attain what they truly need: family and love. Because, as the saying goes: "Money fades, but family endures!"
title: Pokoli rokonok

overview: As a high school senior, Su-Jeong began playing an online game where she met another player nicknamed "Black Dragon". They unexpectedly got close, developing crushes and planning a meeting in real life… that concluded in humiliation and disaster when "Black Dragon" turned out to be an awkward middle schooler instead of the young man he portrayed himself to be! Sixteen years later, Su-Jeong is a skilled planner at Yongseong Department Store, but her job is about to get a shakeup with the arrival of Ban Ju-Yeon, the ambitious new head of strategic planning and heir to the company. There's just one problem: Ban Ju-Yeon is actually "Black Dragon", and Su-Jeong still holds a grudge. Will their past come back to haunt them, or can they find a way to resolve their misunderstandings – and even find love as adults?
title: My Dearest Nemesis

overview: DMD Friendship The Reality is a Thai reality competition series featuring a group of Domundi artist trainees who live, train, and compete together through a series of challenges and missions designed to develop their performance skills and interpersonal chemistry. The core goal of the show is to have the participants explore connections with one another, both personally and professionally, as they work to form compatible pairs ("ships") that can become onscreen couples in the future. Throughout each season, contestants build friendships and potential romantic bonds, are evaluated on various tasks, and interact in ways that test their compatibility on and off camera. The winning couple earns the opportunity to lead roles together in an upcoming Domundi BL series.
title: DMD Friendship The Reality

overview: In 2020, 18-year-old Ellie Williams posted on Facebook about being raped by an 'Asian grooming gang' in Barrow. Her post ruptured community relations. But was it true?
title: Accused: The Fake Grooming Scandal

overview: This drama tells the story of several police officers at a local police station who, in the most complex commercial community, write extraordinary stories in their ordinary positions through the proper handling of various police cases.
title: In The Line of Duty

overview: Xu Miyu's perfect marriage shatters on her 10th anniversary, prompting her to rediscover herself and choose divorce. Starting over as a hotel cleaner at Purong Hotel, she crosses paths with Ji Feng, the hotel's new GM and her former acquaintance. As they face workplace challenges together, love blossoms, and they transform Purong Hotel into a rising city landmark.
title: The Epoch of Miyu

overview: Trainee Constable Su Xiaoqiao swaps identities and appearances with Gu Qingdai, widow of the bandit leader in Qingfeng Village , to investigate her mother's murder. Posing as Gu, Su becomes the bandit stronghold's leader and "marries" Chu Yan who is her undercover
title: Swap Face

overview: Helian Zheng deeply loved his stepsister, He Anran, but witnessed her father imprisoning and causing his mother's death. Five years later, Helian Zheng returned as a warlord, capturing his stepfather and forcing marriage with his stepsister to avenge his mother. Mo Yutang, who grew up depending on Helian Zheng, lost the ability to walk properly because of him. Years later, they reunite, but beneath Mo Yutang's stunning stage makeup hides a deep, bone-chilling hatred...
title: Sadistic Love

overview: Art and culture define us - but in an age of change, who are we now? In divided times, Simon Schama asks whether art, music and words can be the threads that bind us together.
title: Simon Schama's Story of Us

overview: Have you ever wondered whether the grass is greener on the other side of the fence? Two wives discover that it often isn't when they hand over the keys to their homes and literally switch families — but not bedrooms — for two weeks on the new reality show Wife Swap, already a critically-acclaimed smash hit in its third season in the U.K. Wife Swap is not a competition or a contest. It is a reality show unlike any other, where the battlegrounds are the kitchens and living rooms, child-rearing is a subject of intense and heated debate, and the outcome isn't a cash prize, but a couple's opportunity to re-discover why they love each other and decided to marry in the first place. In the first week of the swap, the wives move in with their new family and adopt their very different lifestyle. They agree to follow a manual written by the departing wife that sets out the rules of their new household – how they parent, shop, do the house work, manage their budgets and their social life. But then, in the second week, everything changes. The new wives take charge. They introduce their own set of rules and get to run the new household their way. It's a radical shock to both families. The results are explosive, enlightening and often very funny. This is a show about the things that really matter to families across America. At the end of the show, the two couples meet for the first time. In a highly-charged exchange of views, both couples make a frank assessment of each other and talk about what they've learned from the experience.
title: Wife Swap

overview: Two of a Kind matches one teenager with four strangers to find their secret twin. After taking a personality quiz, the group goes through a series of challenges to determine who's the most compatible. If the teen can guess their secret twin, the group wins big!
title: Two of a Kind

overview: In this brand new series, cameras follow the lives of Stacey and Joe, their children, four ducks and two dogs. With exclusive behind the scenes access, viewers are given a refreshing, honest take on their modern blended family. Raising their ‘pickles', Zach, Leighton, Rex, Rose and Belle who are aged between 16 and one, is no mean feat especially combined with busy work schedules and ambitious passion projects like building a two acre fishing lake.
title: Stacey & Joe

overview: Civil War Combat is a historical documentary series that takes viewers on a journey through the bloodiest battles of the Civil War.
title: Civil War Combat

overview: The comedian Messiah Hallberg examines various parts of our Swedish society and asks himself the question: how the hell did we end up here?
title: Hur fan hamnade vi här?

overview: "Parallel Rotation" is a two-part film about figure skater Alena Kostornaya, who started her career from scratch after winning gold at the European Championships. Everyone expected her to win an Olympic medal, but a series of injuries and controversial decisions almost led to her leaving the sport. Alena did not give up and went into pair skating, where her previous achievements mean nothing.
title: Параллельное вращение

overview: Carla Lane's comedy about one man's devastating effect upon three intelligent women.
title: Screaming

overview: Lee Christiernsson hasn't dated since Facebook was launched 18 years ago. Now, with the 50th anniversary around the corner, Lee dares to bet on love again and posted a personal ad on social media. For the one who once became popular as "Snickar-Björn", it was the start of an emotional journey. How will Lee fare in his pursuit of love? A series about facing new relationships and oneself in a completely new chapter in life.
title: Lee Söker Kärleken

overview: Can lost memories be evoked through paintings? Lars Lerin meets eight elderly people with various dementias and other illnesses. Together with their relatives, they meet to paint, create and go on excursions. At the same time, Lars is busy with his artistry, his own aging and life as a young father of four children together with his husband Junior.
title: Lerin på äldreboendet

overview: Comedian Jonatan Unge is going on a stand-up tour in Europe. With him he has his mainstay in life: mother Cecilia Hagen. It will be a chaotic journey with missed trains, improvised stand ups and unexpected tourist destinations. Maybe the trip is really just an excuse for the big joint mission: to teach Unge to become independent before it's too late.
title: Cecilias Unge

overview: Jens Lapidus follows the game in the courtroom in six known cases. It will be a journey filled with gripping stories and surprising turning points where Lapidus, with his long experience as a lawyer, penetrates behind the headlines of the evening papers and guides us into the world of various criminal cases. What issues will decide the case and why does the court rule as it does?
title: Rättegången

overview: America's feel-good morning show with big stars and sweet surprises; a cast of rotating co-hosts join Jenna Bush Hager for an hour of heartfelt connection, inspirational stories, fun and laughs.
title: Today with Jenna & Friends

overview: Three part dramatisation about five brothers befriended by playwright J. M. Barrie in Kensington Gardens and later adopted by him after their parent's death.
title: The Lost Boys

overview: The Camorra boss known as "The Professor" manages and administers the reformed Camorra from prison. Helped by his faithful sister Rosaria, the man escapes from the penitentiary and creates a powerful criminal organization that manages to infiltrate all levels of society. The never seen before, only TV series ever made by Oscar winner Giuseppe Tornatore. Restored in 4k with the official soundtrack by Oscar winner Nicola Piovani.
title: Il camorrista
Bie Dong Wo De Nan Zhujiao

overview: A successful and renowned novelist — haunted by trauma and a mysterious blackmailer — returns to his hometown to reckon with his unresolved past.
title: Wzgórze psów

overview: Grand Designs Sverige - Återbesöken brings Mark Isitt back to some of the most memorable and spectacular houses in Grand Design's history.
title: Grand Designs Sverige - Återbesöken

overview: Bianca Ingrosso takes the stage at Berns in Stockholm. She invites us and the audience to meet celebrities and enjoy surprises and live music.
title: Bianca by Night

overview: Commander Anne Capestan leads a brigade of the judicial police of Lyon to which only alcoholic, depressed and maladjusted police officers are assigned. Despite this, she managed to successfully process the most important investigation of the moment.
title: Poulets grillés

overview: The show featured news, guest analysis, and interviews. Like other American cable news stations, there is news mixed with feature-like stories, as well as commentary and short debates between people on opposite sides of issues, usually between associates of candidates and officials, think-tank members, and journalists.
title: Fox News Live

overview: Weekend Live was an American news/talk television program on Fox News Channel. The program featured live news story updates from correspondents, analysis from a number of different regular contributors, interviews with newsmakers of the week, and regular subject specific segments. Compared to other programming on the network, it didn't feature a commentary segment, but does have regular one-minute "Fox Real Time" news recaps.
title: Weekend Live

overview: The wealthy heiress Bu Yan is set up and spends a passionate night with boxer He Yuchen, only to disappear afterward. Six years later, she returns with a pair of twins and crosses paths with He Yuchen, who has fallen into despair after a match-fixing scandal. Needing cord blood for her son, Bu Yan decides to use He Yuchen, leading them to enter a contract marriage that turns into real love. They then uncover the dark truths of their past together.
title: Rainkissed Fate

overview: Every story, every trial, every case has at least two sides. In this weekday series, Court TV's Vinnie Politan looks at every angle of the cases making headlines. Dive into the latest true crime stories inside and outside of the courtroom in Vinnie Politan Investigates. Starting Monday, you can watch VPI every weeknight at 9/8c on Court TV and CourtTV.com.
title: Vinnie Politan Investigates

overview: A young mother's life is upended when she finds herself hiding behind a secret identity to escape the Bucharest gang responsible for her fiancé's death.
title: Subteran

overview: When popular vlogger Ruby Franke is arrested for child abuse in August 2023, it quickly becomes one of the biggest trending stories in America. For years, the Frankes' YouTube channel had documented a wholesome, happy family life, with 2.5 million subscribers tuning in at its peak. But happy families are rarely what they seem. As the cracks began to show, the family turned to counselor Jodi Hildebrandt for guidance – and rapidly found themselves trapped in a nightmare. Only the Frankes know what went on inside their home. This series marks the first time Shari and Chad, the Frankes' two eldest adult children, and Kevin, Ruby's husband, will share their story in depth on camera. With exclusive access to the Frankes, their friends and neighbors, and over a thousand hours of their YouTube channel's unseen footage, Devil in the Family: The Fall of Ruby Franke cuts through the social media reaction to explore the untold story behind the Ruby Franke case: part family tragedy, part coming-of-age narrative, part tale of our times about the perils of life lived online.
title: Devil in the Family: The Fall of Ruby Franke

overview: The Chef's Garden joins Farmer Lee Jones on his farm as he meets with renowned chefs from across the country to celebrate fresh produce and regenerative agriculture with aspirational, creative dishes. In each half hour episode, The Chef's Garden brings viewers to the farm and into its industrial kitchen, the Culinary Vegetable Institute, where Farmer Lee and his chef friends—some of the most celebrated names in the industry including Emma Bengtsson, Curtis Duffy, Jenner Tomaska, and Rachael Ray — use the inspiration from the farm to experiment and cook together. Utilizing the ingredients around them, the chefs create dishes ranging from beat granita with cured salmon and chilled corn soup to Thai spiced shepherd's pie and crab meat stuffed burrata with roasted watermelon and tomatoes.
title: The Chef's Garden
